experiment: synthetic semantic and revision policy checks
limits: No AI, browser, real sources, application runtime, load, latency or cost measurement. Four-option comparison is design analysis, not four implemented systems.

checks.check: same label has separate meanings; accepted contextual synonym joins
unknown relation is not silently in exact normalized results
repair removes false positive without rewriting original evidence
label edit keeps exact query identity
reviewed concept merge preserves statement identities
scope correction preserves shared snapshot and supplies explicit comparison
new mapping makes the same statement available to exact search
cyclic interval crosses origin without becoming reversed date range
qualitative axis and undated note are not coerced to dates

qualitative.coordinateMeaning: 回想内の段階順。距離や年数を示さない

checks.check: pinned model screen identifies preserved current subset

policy_comparison.A_predefined_catalog: Can expose every record after upfront relation/time definitions and renderer work; four relations fit current published model. This is not an upper bound on option A.
policy_comparison.B_uniform_assertion: All 11 preserve text/evidence immediately; eight endpoint relations can draw once identity is checked. Exact concept query includes only reviewed assignments.
policy_comparison.C_typed_core_fallback: Four fit existing typed core; four relations and three episode/note records need fallback and shared discovery. Same coverage as B only after cross-regime contracts.
policy_comparison.D_dossier_event: All 11 can remain source-linked blocks in a theme; cross-theme exact relation results require an extracted assertion index with mapping and correction responsibilities.
